name: adhd-ops
description: Executive-function support patterns for ADHD brains, plus a code-walkthrough plugin built on the same principles.

plugins.name: adhd-ops
plugins.description: The full loop: a delta-first morning brief with One Big Thing and the 3-strike rule, an end-of-day shutdown email that celebrates wins and parks open loops with next steps, the /gsd rescue command with a once-a-day scheduled poke, the /park zero-ceremony capture inbox, weekly follow-up triage that re-verifies every task's claims against live state, and a monthly retro that reads the system's own telemetry and proposes exactly one tuning change. Ships as a template -- fill in the workspace-config skill with your own calendars, task list, state store, and voice.

plugins.name: code-walkthrough
plugins.description: Interactive, step-by-step walkthroughs of code, published as a page: story on the left, the exact code on the right (pinned to a commit, every line number linked to GitHub), a map of where the code lives, diagrams whose parts light up the lines they stand for, and a checkpoint after every chapter that asks before it tells: predict what the code does, or tap the line that does it, then see why. Starts with a critical-path analysis so nothing is explained before what it depends on, and ends with a teaching and ADHD-friendliness review, half mechanical and half by an independent reviewer. A zero-dependency script resolves every snippet from git by its exact text, so line numbers, code and answers can't be invented. Works on repos, PRs, unpushed branches and plain folders.
